objective: Implement the GET /profiles/{id} FastAPI endpoint returning 200 {id, name} or 404 per contract C1, reading through the frozen Cache interface C2, with API tests for hit, miss, and 404
non_goals: Do not touch app/cache.py (T02 owns it; consume it through contract C2 only)
Do not touch app/db/** or app/main.py
Do not add write-path invalidation (Stage non-goal)
implementation_constraints: Read-through order is load-bearing: cache.get first, store fetch + cache.set only on miss
Unknown id returns 404 with the C1 error shape; never 500 for a missing profile

deliverables.what: API tests for hit, miss, and 404

acceptance_tests.description: GET /profiles/{known} returns 200 with body fields id and name
acceptance_tests.evidence: pytest tests/api/test_profiles.py::test_get_known_200 asserts status_code == 200 and name field present

acceptance_tests.description: on a cache miss the endpoint fetches from the store, writes the cache entry, and returns the store value
acceptance_tests.evidence: pytest tests/api/test_profiles.py::test_miss_populates_cache asserts cache.get returns the value after the call

failure_cases.expected_behavior: 503 with error.code 'store_unavailable' (per A1), the cache is not populated

handoff.notes: record the exact response field list in verified_facts for the T03 E2E gate
